housing-numbers.notes: Housing requirement is a range of 2,650-2,900 dwellings over the plan period (2006-2026), equating to 132.5-145 dwellings per annum. Allocated housing includes 104 from Strategic Housing Allocations (Policy CS6) and 345 from Major Developed Sites (Policy CS7). Committed housing includes dwellings built 2006-2011 (636) plus those with planning permission at March 2011 (799 total committed). Windfall figure is for small unidentified sites in years 11-15 only.
